10. Dispute Resolution: Any dispute, controversy and / or claim arising out of and / or relating to this Agreement, including its performance, construction, interpretation, meaning, scope, operation, effect and / or validity thereof ("Dispute"), shall be resolved by arbitration, administered electronically by Presolv360, an independent institution, in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules ("Rules"). The arbitration shall be before a sole arbitrator appointed under the Rules. The juridical seat of arbitration shall be Bengaluru, Karnataka. The language of arbitration shall be English. The decision of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on the Parties.
